title: Empty LLM choices retry has no limit, allowing infinite clock drain
description:
In `pilot.py:720`, the `if not response.choices` check retries indefinitely via `continue` in the while loop. Empty *content* responses have a 10-retry limit (`empty_responses >= 10` at line 1055), but empty *choices* responses do not.

In game_20260303_000030_g3, Gemini 3.1 Pro returned empty/null choices on 52 out of 153 LLM calls (34%). Each retry costs ~10-20s of wall clock, which burned ~30 minutes of the 60-minute match timer. The model ultimately lost by timeout while having a survivable board position.

The match timer provides a ceiling, but the model could have played many more meaningful turns if it auto-passed after N consecutive empty choices instead of retrying forever.

Suggested fix: Add a consecutive empty-choices counter similar to the empty-content counter. After 5-10 consecutive empty choices, switch to auto-pass mode to preserve clock time for future turns where the API may recover.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260303_000030_g3/Gem31P Analyst_pilot.log: 52 instances of 'LLM returned empty/null choices, retrying...'
- Source: puppeteer/src/puppeteer/pilot.py:720
